# contract-check: skip-install  reason: ~300 MB of NER deps (transformers, onnxruntime) plus a python-mecab-ko C-extension compile, for an opt-in feature. PR lane skips; nightly --install-all installs and verifies.
gliner
# sentencepiece comes in unpinned through gliner. 0.2.3 ships sentencepiece_model_pb2
# generated by protobuf 7.36.1 without requiring protobuf>=7, and weaviate-client keeps
# the engine's protobuf below 7, so GLiNER's tokenizer load fails with "incompatible
# Protobuf Gencode/Runtime versions". 0.2.1 loads on protobuf 6. Drop the pin once
# protobuf can move to 7.
sentencepiece==0.2.1
# needed for gliner_ko
python-mecab-ko
# onnxruntime is an indirect dep (via gliner), not imported here.
# One shared version across every onnxruntime consumer, so the ~200 MB runtime installs once.
# rtmlib/gliner declare it unpinned and faster-whisper wants <2,>=1.14 -- the exact number is
# ours to choose, but all these files must agree. 1.20.1 was withdrawn from PyPI for the -gpu
# build (the CPU build of it survives), which is why this moved; 1.20.2 is the mirror trap --
# it exists only for -gpu, so pinning it would break macOS.
onnxruntime-gpu==1.22.0; platform_system != 'Darwin'
onnxruntime==1.22.0; platform_system == 'Darwin'
